description: Read saved composition schemas. Use it when listing saved work or loading a named schema; use schema_store to save or delete one. Returns metadata or the schema with a new process-local schemaRef, valid for 30 minutes. Tool input schemas are separate MCP resources. Full schema: oods://schemas/schema_read.input.json.

name.description: Saved schema name in slug format. Actions: load (required).

name: schema_read
title: Read Saved Schemas
